A 3D light show on Budapest's basilica.

At Budapest's Advent Feast, a 3D light show is projected onto St. Stephen's Basilica several times each evening, with an ice rink around the tree.
Eat lángos, kürtőskalács, goulash in a bread bowl and beigli.
The Vörösmarty fair has been card-only in recent seasons.

7+ Christmas markets, all walkable.

Cologne has seven or more major Christmas markets, all within walking distance.
The Cathedral market has around 150 stalls under a canopy of lights, and there's an angels' market, a harbour market and even a market boat on the Rhine.
The main station is right next to the cathedral.

Rothenburg after 5 pm is pure magic.

Rothenburg ob der Tauber is busy with day-trippers, but after the buses leave around 5 pm it becomes wonderfully peaceful.
Try a Schneeball pastry, join the Night Watchman's Tour and walk the covered town walls.
The Reiterlesmarkt is expected Nov 27 – Dec 23, 2026.
